suites.title: TOOL-2 Customer registration, sign-in and account protection

specs.title: SCN-001: Registration creates the customer without echoing the password

steps.title: When I post a new customer with a unique e-mail address to POST /users/register
Then the response status is 201
And the response has an id and my first name, last name and e-mail address
And the response does not contain the password

specs.title: SCN-002: A registered e-mail address cannot register twice

steps.title: Given a customer already registered with an e-mail address
[SEED] registered customer (API; not deletable)
When the same e-mail address is registered again
Then the response status is 409
And the message is "A customer with this email address already exists."

specs.title: SCN-003: Weak passwords are rejected with every broken rule listed

steps.title: When a new customer registers with the password "abc"
Then the response status is 422
And the password errors name the 8-character minimum, upper and lower case letters, a symbol and a number

specs.title: SCN-004: Signing in on the web shop

steps.title: Given a registered customer on the web shop's sign-in page
[SEED] registered customer (API; not deletable)
When they sign in with their e-mail address and password
Then they land on the "My account" page
And the navigation shows their first and last name

specs.title: SCN-005: A wrong password is refused by the API

steps.title: Given a registered customer
[SEED] registered customer (API; not deletable)
When they POST their e-mail address with a wrong password to /users/login
Then the response status is 401

specs.title: SCN-006: A wrong password is refused on the web shop

steps.title: Given a registered customer on the web shop's sign-in page
[SEED] registered customer (API; not deletable)
When they sign in with a wrong password
Then the web shop shows "Invalid email or password"

specs.title: SCN-008: Signing out invalidates the token

steps.title: Given a signed-in customer with an access token
[SEED] registered customer (API; not deletable)
[SEED] sign in (POST /users/login)
When they sign out with GET /users/logout
Then GET /users/me with the same token responds 401
